# airflow_dag (List Resource)

Lists all Airflow DAGs. Use with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later) to enumerate existing DAGs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "airflow_dag" "all" {
  provider         = airflow
  include_resource = true
}
```
